bulletin.text: On 19 September 2026, the 48-hour outlook covers fires detected on 18 September 2026. There are 506 Priority 1 fires, 80 Priority 2 fires, and 0 Priority 3 fires. The top 10 Priority 1 fires account for 40% of all modelled smoke over residents. The leading fire near Kayong Utara contributes 7.8%, with smoke heading NW and first reaching Kubu Raya, Kota Pontianak, and Mempawah in 2 hours; 2,949,984 residents are within 40 km of its smoke path. The second fire near Ketapang contributes 6.4% and reaches its top places in 8 hours, with 2,642,265 residents within 40 km. The third fire near Kayong Utara contributes 4.7% and reaches top places in 3 hours, with 3,175,282 residents within 40 km. Seven fires left the top 10. This is a ranking index, not a forecast of smoke concentration. People outside Indonesia are not counted. The task force decides.
